parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MatchedHost
parameters.description: The domain name to which the API operation belongs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page. Paging starts from page 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page. Paging starts from page 1.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: SensitiveCode
parameters.description:
The sensitive data type.
> You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported sensitive data types.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.
